summary: Set no_log: false under controller, hub or eda in the AAP CR to show output of failed tasks (may expose secrets, so revert in production) and add the annotation ansible.sdk.operatorframework.io/verbosity: "4" for more playbook verbosity.
questions: How do I see hidden task output in AAP operator logs?
How do I increase AAP operator log verbosity?
What does no_log false do in the AAP CR?

answer_card.title: Debug output from the operator
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
metadata:
  name: myaap
  annotations:
    ansible.sdk.operatorframework.io/verbosity: "4"
spec:
  controller:
    no_log: false   # also hub / eda
```
Set `no_log` back to `true` on production: it can expose sensitive data.
